description: Utility functions for handling key information and metadata, including filtering sensitive fields, extracting logging settings, formatting metadata as JSON, and removing 'tags' from metadata objects.

methods.name: filterSensitiveMetadata
methods.description: Filters out sensitive information (like 'logging') from metadata for safe display.

methods.name: extractLoggingSettings
methods.description: Extracts an array of logging configurations from metadata.

methods.name: formatMetadataForDisplay
methods.description: Formats metadata for display as JSON string, filtering out sensitive fields.

methods.name: stripTagsFromMetadata
methods.description: Removes the 'tags' property from a metadata object to avoid duplication in UI.
